source: Go bake: cmd/bakeathletes/pose.go (body.pose, body.clips, rootClips) of the game checkout, sampled as author.Model.clip does: key i at Linspace(0, 1, keys)[i] * duration, root and rotations in float64 before the GLB writer rounds them
units: time in seconds; root in yards (the game file is in yards, Greenware writes metres); rotations are unit quaternions x, y, z, w; a joint the pose leaves out is the identity
